import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

# Test imports
from models.smkd import SMKD, VisualModule, ContextualModule, NormalisedClassifier
from losses import SMKDLoss, batch_gsba, CTCLoss, gsba, FocalCTCLoss
from dataset import PhoenixDataset, collate_fn, Vocabulary
from metrics import compute_wer, edit_distance
print('[PASS] All imports OK')

# Test SMKD with new params
model = SMKD(num_classes=20, d_model=64, hidden_size=64, backbone='resnet18',
             temporal_conv_type='standard', multi_scale_temporal=False, use_tsm=False)
model.set_stage(1)
x = torch.randn(2, 16, 3, 64, 64)
out = model(x)
print(f'[PASS] SMKD forward: v={out[\"logits_v\"].shape}, g={out[\"logits_g\"].shape}')

# Test depthwise-separable
model_dw = SMKD(num_classes=20, d_model=64, hidden_size=64, temporal_conv_type='depthwise_separable')
model_dw.set_stage(1)
out2 = model_dw(x)
print(f'[PASS] Depthwise-separable forward: {out2[\"logits_v\"].shape}')

# Test multi-scale
model_ms = SMKD(num_classes=20, d_model=64, hidden_size=64, multi_scale_temporal=True, multi_scale_dilation_rates=[1,2])
model_ms.set_stage(1)
out3 = model_ms(x)
print(f'[PASS] Multi-scale forward: {out3[\"logits_v\"].shape}')

# Test MobileNetV3
model_mb = SMKD(num_classes=20, d_model=64, hidden_size=64, backbone='mobilenet_v3_small')
model_mb.set_stage(1)
out4 = model_mb(x)
print(f'[PASS] MobileNet forward: {out4[\"logits_v\"].shape}')

# Test enhanced SMKDLoss
criterion = SMKDLoss(blank=0, alpha=0.5, feature_alignment_enabled=True,
                     entropy_reg_enabled=True, focal_ctc_enabled=True)
B, T, C = 2, 10, 21
logits_v = torch.randn(B, T, C)
logits_g = torch.randn(B, T, C)
lvf = torch.randn(B, T, 64)
gcf = torch.randn(B, T, 64)
targets = torch.tensor([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], dtype=torch.long)
il = torch.tensor([T, T], dtype=torch.long)
tl = torch.tensor([3, 3], dtype=torch.long)
seg = torch.randint(-1, 19, (B, T))
margins = torch.rand(B, T)
loss, d = criterion(logits_v, logits_g, targets, il, tl, stage=1, lvf=lvf, gcf=gcf)
print(f'[PASS] Enhanced SMKDLoss stage 1: {d}')
loss2, d2 = criterion(logits_v, logits_g, targets, il, tl, stage=2, seg_labels=seg, seg_margins=margins, lvf=lvf, gcf=gcf)
print(f'[PASS] Enhanced SMKDLoss stage 2: {d2}')

print()
print('All checks passed!')
